roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Family Finding & Engagement

bullets: Own product strategy and roadmap for Family Finding & Engagement.
Translate the needs of family finding specialists, social workers, supervisors, and kin caregivers into a clear multi-year vision and a sharp quarterly roadmap.
Drive the metrics that matter: kinship placement rates, connections identified per child, time from case opening to first relative contact, outreach response rates, and placement…
Identify where AI can transform family finding — inferring relationships from unstructured case records, surfacing connections buried in notes, drafting and translating outreach…
Prototype rapidly using AI tools (Claude, Figma, Cursor, v0) to test ideas with users in days, not weeks. We expect PMs to use AI aggressively in their own workflows.
